title: Green-screen proof
one_liner: You talk in front of the real page you're reacting to, with a highlighter hook, a source chip and a red pen mark on the exact line as you say it.
best_for: Industry news, answering a comment, myth-busting

palette.use: hand-drawn circle / underline on the key line
hook text, caption box, source chip

pace: 20-45 s at 1.1-1.3x (demo 27.3 s at 1.15x); the page changes on the sentence that starts the next point
signature_moves: Real web page captured at phone width, credited with a source chip
Red pen mark drawn on the exact words as you say the matching line
A cut-out of you in front of the page; the page scrolls in for each new point
